metadata.name: Vinefall Sanctum
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: An overgrown temple city split by a river gorge (Style Pack 06: Jungle Ruins). The Embers hold the south sanctum, the Tide the north; each has a stepped ziggurat with a shrine on top (a sniper rifle at the altar), two carved temples with portcullis gates and roofs you can run, waterfalls with a way through behind the falls, and a timber watch tower at each end. Cross the gorge by three rope bridges, by the high rope and stone bridges between the terraces 4 m up, or wade the river below (dynamite and heavy armour down there; gorge steps and vines lead out).
